HLL: [HyperLogLog](https://datasketches.apache.org/docs/HLL/HllSketches.html) distinct-counting sketch — the industry standard. Fast serialize/deserialize and broad cross-system compatibility. Build with [`datasketch_hll`](#datasketch_hll), read with [`datasketch_hll_estimate`](#datasketch_hll_estimate), merge with [`datasketch_hll_union`](#datasketch_hll_union). Choose this when speed and interop matter more than storage.
CPC: [Compressed Probability Counting](https://datasketches.apache.org/docs/CPC/CpcSketches.html) — distinct-counting at roughly 40% the size of HLL at the same accuracy, traded against slower serialization. Build with [`datasketch_cpc`](#datasketch_cpc), read with [`datasketch_cpc_estimate`](#datasketch_cpc_estimate), merge with [`datasketch_cpc_union`](#datasketch_cpc_union). Choose this when you store many sketches at rest.
Theta: [Theta sketch](https://datasketches.apache.org/docs/Theta/ThetaSketches.html) — the only distinct-count family that supports set operations beyond union. Use [`datasketch_theta_union`](#datasketch_theta_union), [`datasketch_theta_intersect`](#datasketch_theta_intersect), and [`datasketch_theta_a_not_b`](#datasketch_theta_a_not_b) to combine cohorts without rescanning the source data.
Frequent Items: [Heavy-hitter sketch](https://datasketches.apache.org/docs/Frequency/FrequentItemsOverview.html) that identifies the most-frequent items in a stream along with confidence-bounded frequency estimates. Build with [`datasketch_frequent_items`](#datasketch_frequent_items), read top-N with [`datasketch_frequent_items_get_frequent`](#datasketch_frequent_items_get_frequent). Use for top-N analysis on high-cardinality streams.
KLL: [KLL quantile sketch](https://datasketches.apache.org/docs/KLL/KLLSketch.html) — modern mergeable quantile estimator. Best balance of accuracy, speed, and size for general-purpose quantile work. Build with [`datasketch_kll`](#datasketch_kll), read with [`datasketch_kll_quantile`](#datasketch_kll_quantile) / [`datasketch_kll_rank`](#datasketch_kll_rank) / [`datasketch_kll_cdf`](#datasketch_kll_cdf). Default choice unless you have a specific reason to pick TDigest or REQ.
TDigest: [t-digest](https://datasketches.apache.org/docs/tdigest/tdigest.html) — quantile sketch optimized for the tails (p99, p999). Most accurate where SLOs live; FLOAT/DOUBLE input only. Build with [`datasketch_tdigest`](#datasketch_tdigest), read with [`datasketch_tdigest_quantile`](#datasketch_tdigest_quantile) / [`datasketch_tdigest_rank`](#datasketch_tdigest_rank). Use when tail latencies or outliers matter more than median accuracy.
REQ: [Relative-error quantile sketch](https://datasketches.apache.org/docs/REQ/ReqSketch.html). Error scales with rank rather than being fixed across the distribution — predictable accuracy on highly skewed data. Build with [`datasketch_req`](#datasketch_req), read with [`datasketch_req_quantile`](#datasketch_req_quantile) / [`datasketch_req_rank`](#datasketch_req_rank).
Quantiles: Classic [mergeable quantile sketch](https://datasketches.apache.org/docs/Quantiles/ClassicQuantilesSketch.html) from the original DataSketches paper. Solid general-purpose choice supporting all numeric types; KLL is now preferred for new projects. Build with [`datasketch_quantiles`](#datasketch_quantiles).
